name: Burning Bush
overview: The burning bush represents a miraculous manifestation of God's presence, where the bush burned with fire yet was not consumed, capturing Moses' attention as a sign of divine holiness and purpose (Exodus 3:2-3). God calls Moses from the midst of the bush, commanding reverence by declaring the ground holy and instructing him to remove his sandals (Exodus 3:4-5). This event, also referenced in Acts 7:30, marks a pivotal moment of God's revelation and commissioning of Moses for His redemptive plan.
